mentions.name: Fluffy Sparrow
mentions.description: A simple, frictionless journaling tool focused on being lightweight yet powerful. It supports taking notes, creating and marking to-dos done, organizing notes and to-dos in projects or tags, inline calculation using fend, powerful undo/redo, and archiving unneeded notes. All data is stored in a single text file with no online interaction. Planned features include time tracking, kanban, read-later links, and scripting in the same simple interface.
mentions.source_excerpt: Working on my simple, frictionless journaling tool, that focuses on simplicity, and being lightweight, but still quite powerful.
